flows.name: The build loads on an enUS client with no Lua errors and its tracker text is unchanged
steps: Install the PR's shipped files as the ShortestPathForever folder (compare: no differing files; extra media/icon-400.png) beside ForeverCore v1.10.0-dev+c75429c and /reload
Run errors --addon ShortestPathForever: no Lua errors found
Follow a /way journey so the Journey section shows in the tracker
Confirm the Journey section draws its lines as before
The ruRU separator itself cannot show on an enUS client; the mock render in the PR body shows it with the ruRU font
